identity_statement: Per cell, strict gap - broad gap = (R_SL - R_EN) - ((R_SL+P_SL) - (R_EN+P_EN)) = P_EN - P_SL, the between-language PARTIAL-share difference. 'The gap range is explained by PARTIAL' is an algebraic identity and is NOT reported as a finding; only C3-i/ii/iii are findings.
